phases.scope: governance authority and fail-closed inventory gate
phases.rollback: revert the focused governance commit; no runtime or data change

phases.scope: user-visible README, frontend descriptions, UI, CLI and API metadata consume the root-derived product display
phases.predecessor: IDENTITY-0 plus exact Core and UX file leases
phases.rollback: revert projection commits before release; no alias removal

phases.scope: build, package and manifest versions consume or verify the root authority
phases.rollback: restore prior projection commit and artifacts; published tags are never rewritten

phases.scope: optional binary, service, package, install-path and module renames
phases.predecessor: complete consumer graph, compatibility aliases, platform install/upgrade and rollback evidence
phases.rollback: retain old launchers and paths until the new identity is independently verified; persisted identifiers use forward migration or backup restore

phases.scope: create the release tag derived from the root authority
phases.predecessor: User-authorized clean release candidate with all mandatory gates and a signed external receipt bound to exact artifacts
phases.rollback: not applicable: tags and published artifacts are immutable; a bad release is superseded
